name: KAWAII LAB. Transit Timetable DB v2
purpose: Train-centric scheduled-timetable database for route search with explicit same-train continuity and destination preservation.

TrainTimetableFragment.notes: One source timetable fragment. A physical train may have multiple fragments across railway/operator boundaries.

SameTrainEdge.notes: Directed continuation edge. Routing may preserve transfer count only across these edges.

NetworkJourney.notes: An exact source that already describes one physical train across multiple railway IDs.

transferRule: Increment transfer count only when the next boarded train is not connected to the current train by an explicit same-train edge or exact network journey continuation.
